text:
```yaml
name: Weekly UV Lock Update

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Monday at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-uv-lock:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Update uv.lock
        run: uv lock

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet uv.lock; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          commit-message: "chore: update uv.lock"
          title: "chore: update uv.lock"
          body: |
            Automated weekly update of `uv.lock` file.
            
            This PR was generated by the `weekly-uv-lock` workflow.
          branch: "chore/update-uv-lock"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            dependencies
            automated
```
